QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Collecting the Metal Element
QuestInfo.0: #p9111001# gives you the Metal Element she extracted from #p9111022#. Deliver it to #p9111000#.
QuestInfo.1: #p9111000# is furious that #p9111001# is up and about despite her illness. Deliver the Metal Element to Kino Konoko.
QuestInfo.2: #p9111000# was pleased that you recovered the Element and has allowed #p9111011# stay at the Mushroom Shrine to keep an eye on #p9111001#.
